authority: OWNER directive 3 §29 / interim §9 (2026-09-16) — PATTERN_FILTER programme, RESEARCH+SPECIFICATION slice
commissioned_by: Fable (OWNER seat) via a signed commission artifact at decisions/ before any enqueue

q12_contract.semantics: BLACKLIST_v1 (QM_PatternProfileMode: a firing predicate BLOCKS its side; whitelist is a physically different experiment, OWNER E0-3)
q12_contract.filter_cap_note: cap=3 is a SELECTION parameter (not a Hard Rule); this programme tests exactly 1 filter per base, never combinations, never a stack
q12_contract.adoption_rule: The ablation is a mechanistic candidate screen ONLY. Q12's sealed DL-089 rule (full-matrix census, consistency >=2/3 years >=+5% return_to_maxdd vs same-year baseline, activity floor, WF stability) remains the sole authority that decides which filters an EA runs. A positive ablation read-out obliges a full census program before any adoption; a negative read-out ends the hypothesis. No gate contract is edited.
q12_contract.implementation_note: opt_census.enqueue() pins planned_trials==1085, so inside today's lane each trial executes as its own full DL-089 census program (155 arms x 7 years, declared_trial_count=154 per program); the ablation read-out is restricted to the pre-registered single predicate per direction. A reduced 3-arm plan would need a code change decision by Fable (see open questions in the design doc).

multiple_testing_control.fdr_scope: WITHIN each pre-registered family, at programme level over the 11 base hypotheses (per-direction arms are repeated measurement, not additional hypotheses)
multiple_testing_control.trial_counting: 1 hypothesis = (base, predicate) across BOTH directions = 2 declared direction-trials; calendar years are repeated measurement (DL-089 §5), never trials
multiple_testing_control.q16_deflation: The 22 declared direction-trials are logged in search_history_ledger (families pattern_filter.*) BEFORE any enqueue and feed Q16 DSR/PBO deflation of any configuration that adopts a filter; per-program census deflation stays declared_trial_count=154. NEVER silently.

trial_template.combinations_rule: Explicitly none. No stacks, no pairs, no power-set. One predicate per base, one base+predicate trial each.
trial_template.null_control: baseline (NO_FILTER) arm is mandatory in every year and is the control every overlay is measured against (same program, same year)
measurements: trade count / trade reduction vs same-(base,year) baseline
per-trade expectancy and expectancy delta vs base
max drawdown and drawdown delta vs base
portfolio marginal effect (correlation & tail contribution to the DXZ/FTMO book)

kill_criteria.expectancy_drop_rule: kill if relative per-trade expectancy drops >5% vs base in >=2/3 of the 7 measured years (any single year >10% is an immediate kill)
kill_criteria.trade_reduction_rule: kill if trade reduction exceeds 20% in any year without a >=+5% relative return_to_maxdd gain in that same year
kill_criteria.positive_readout_rule: a passing read-out only promotes the predicate to a full DL-089 census program; the sealed selection rule decides adoption

base.value_basis: Live DXZ sleeve (0.0431% risk); dense intraday session breakout; DL-089 pilot family (original census subject); FTMO-shape priority
base.entry_logic: H1 stop breakout of the completed 03:00-06:00 GMT+3 range, both sides, evening resolution 18:00 GMT+3, ATR range filter 0.4x-2.5x

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist entries whose 06:00 GMT+3 order-placement bar (the completed final range bar) is a wide-range bar: an expanded final range bar means the breakout is already underway (chase location) or the range formed on news displacement; Balke's edge is quiet-range resolution, so WRB-triggered entries have degraded follow-through.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp_buy1..3/opt_pp_sell1..3 and passes opt_census.validate_base_setfile; census EA owns a done/PASS Q02 row

base.value_basis: Live DXZ sleeve (0.379% risk); session-flat M15 index intraday (16:30-22:45, hard session close) — closest qualified analogue of the H-CW FTMO profile
base.entry_logic: M15 close above first-4-bar opening range AND prior D1 high after a compressed D1 setup (<=0.65x ATR20), 3R target, trail, session-flat exit

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist M15 breakout entries when the deterministic exhaustion regime fires on the signal bar: a trend-day breakout attempted into an exhaustion-flagged tape is a failed-breakout candidate (the compressed D1 is a terminal coil, not a trend-day base).
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: Live DXZ sleeve (0.053% risk); intraday H1 week-open fade; DL-089 census near-miss program (BUY-hour 52 failed 2/4-vs-3 stability — motivates a shape-based, not hour-based, second look)
base.entry_logic: Fade failed breaks of the prior Monday range: H1 close back inside the Monday box after a wick sweep beyond it; stop beyond sweep extreme; weekly force-flat Friday

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist sweep-fade entries whose close-back-inside bar is a spinning top: an indecision-body close back inside the box carries no rejection conviction; the WolfWeb fade is only valid when the rejection bar is decisive.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: DXZ v2 new sleeve (0.089% burn-in risk); H1 intraday contraction-liquidity breakout on gold; DL-089 census program with wf_unstable=true (no reproducible filter found yet — fresh causal thesis needed)
base.entry_logic: H1 close through the prior liquidity high/low after a confirmed pivot contraction (two lower highs + two higher lows); ATR stop, fixed 2R target

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist liquidity-break entries fired while the regime classifier flags a transition bar: contraction breaks triggered in trend birth/death chop are noise breakouts, not orderly continuation.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: Qualified NDX sleeve (PRE60 news temporal, CONFIG_LOCKED); H4 trend-continuation family with clean regime-conditional hypothesis
base.entry_logic: H4 wedge-continuation entries (both envelope trends rising for long / falling for short) with structural invalidation exits and ATR emergency stop

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist continuation entries when the deterministic trend-strength classifier says ranging: a wedge-continuation signal in a ranging tape is a coin flip; the strategy's edge requires a trending regime. (Census trade-reduction for 79 is a small positive = descriptive anomaly under blacklist semantics; expected reduction here is low because the predicate fires rarely on H4.)
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: Live DXZ sleeve (0.305% risk); D1 cloud-cross trend system; replicates the ABL-005 ranging-blacklist mechanism on a different strategy class and symbol (regime-family replication)
base.entry_logic: D1 Tenkan/Kijun cross with cloud-side confirmation; opposite-signal or ATR-stop/1.5R/framework exits

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist Tenkan/Kijun cross entries while the trend-strength classifier says ranging: crosses in a ranging tape are whipsaw fuel and cloud-side confirmation does not rescue direction in chop.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: Qualified GBPUSD sleeve; Connors RSI(2) pullback family (the farm's best-replicated MR class); MR entries are the class where vol-state blacklists have the clearest mechanism
base.entry_logic: D1 RSI(2) pullback fade: buy close>SMA200 with RSI(2)<10 after a down close; mirror short; RSI(2) mid-line exits; 2xATR hard stop

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist RSI(2) fade entries fired during volatility expansion: dips that keep expanding are knife acceleration, not exhaustion; the MR edge lives in quiet tapes.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: Qualified requal8 port of the live 12567 cum-rsi2-commodity sleeve (0.7465% live risk — the heaviest commodity sleeve); long-only gold dip-buying with a statistical-overextension failure mode
base.entry_logic: D1 long when close>SMA200 and RSI(2)[1]+RSI(2)[2]<35; 2.5xATR stop; RSI(2)>65 or 5-bar time stop exit; news blackout on entries

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist long entries when the D1 close sits at a high statistical z-score vs its recent window: a cum-RSI2 dip signal firing while price is still statistically extended is an early-knife long in an overbought market, not a discounted entry.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned (requal8 row); NOTE q10_news_verdict carries REVIEW_REQUIRED flag in candidate_universe.csv — commission only after that flag is dispositioned

base.value_basis: Qualified USDCAD sleeve; D1 two-bar MA-breakout family (setup already excludes inside bars, so the pattern gate at the trigger bar is a non-redundant shape layer); DL-089 repair priority 3 (490 unmeasured B2/B5 cells)
base.entry_logic: D1 stop-order breakout above/below the two-bar extreme when both lows/highs sit on one side of SMA(18) and neither setup bar is an inside bar; stop beyond opposite extreme capped at 80 pips; 2R target

trials.hypothesis_mechanism: Blacklist stop-breakout entries on a doji trigger bar: a directionless decision bar (open ~= close) at the close-through-trigger means the setup had no follow-through conviction; doji-triggered breaks are the classic failed-breakout population.
trials.activation_precondition: base setfile exposes opt_pp inputs and passes validate_base_setfile; Q02 PASS row owned

base.value_basis: DXZ v2 new sleeve (0.373% risk, PRE60_POST60 news temporal); long-only index MR fade — the D1 index representative that complements the M15/H1 intraday FTMO priority picks
